measurements.scope: passive PCB interconnect only: copper propagation and, where a model is declared, via vertical transit. Excludes driver output delay and output-to-output skew, package delay, receiver threshold behaviour and PVT variation.

covered_gaps.justification: the receptacle brings each data line out on two terminals whose order along the land row is D-, D+, D-, D+, so the two links that join each line's pair of terminals are non-planar and one of them must cross the other conductor on the back layer. What interrupts the plane under a front conductor is that crossing, the suppressor's rail conductor, the conductor's own layer change and one unpourable strip between two of them - priced from this board's own track width, via diameter, clearance and minimum pour width, and nothing else: the plane under the pair is closed to every other conductor and the front pour is kept out of the pair's corridor. Each is a fraction of a millimetre against a 25 mm run whose whole length is lumped at this interface's edge rate, so carrying the model across them changes no conclusion this board draws
